name: Hindi
notes: Around 600 million speakers including second-language use, mostly across northern India. Written in Devanagari, which is fully phonetic — every character has one sound, so once you know the script you can read anything aloud. Hindi and Urdu are essentially the same spoken language written in two different scripts.
syllabus: The whole Devanagari script — vowels, vowel signs, consonants and the dotted letters — and about 140 words and phrases, roughly a quarter of CEFR A1 (500 words). Enough to read any word aloud, count, name the family and the body, and ask for what you need. Hindi and Urdu are the same spoken language, so this carries across to Pakistan too; only the script differs.
